arch_bootstrap.note: Arch bootstrap userland 2026.11.01 the pinned base — the STARTING point, not the result: build.sh fully upgrades it (pacman -Syu, a partial -Sy upgrade is unsupported on Arch) and re-resolves the package set from the current repos, so kernel/node/python float with the repo state. Exact installed versions are recorded in images/manifest.json.
